title: Single sign-on (OpenID Connect)
notes: Built-in single sign-on with any OpenID Connect provider (Okta, Auth0, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Authentik, Keycloak…). Configure it under Admin → Single sign-on: issuer URL + client id/secret, add the shown redirect URI to your provider, and members get a “Sign in with …” button.

changelog.text: Single sign-on via OpenID Connect — connect any OIDC provider under Admin → Single sign-on, with optional auto-create and email-domain restriction.
